body:
In addition to the statistics analysis deffect, it provide a big dump of performance, maybe to link with this ticket : 
https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/issues/5237

For example on our side, we were using `useHits` in every `HitComponent` and we are displaying 100 hits by page.
That was producing nearly 500 to 1000 HTTP requests only to send `viewed` events when page display. 😆
